full_judgment: 2. The facts leading to the issuance of the Rule in a nutshell can be stated thus, the present opposite party no.1 being pre-emptor filed the original miscellaneous case in the court of learned Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Jhenaidah contending inter alia that the pre-emptor is a house wife and residing in Dhaka with her husband. Coming to her father's residence situated at Jhenidah the pre-emptor came to learn on 09.02.1997 that the opposite party no. 2 transferred the case land measuring 2½  decimals in favour of the opposite party no.1 on 30.01.1995 A.D. The pre-emptor-opposite party no.1 is a co-sharer by purchase the case joie after purchasing the land appertaining to S.A. Khatian No. 140/1 in plot no, 190 measuring an area of .05 acres of land from the original owner of the land opposite party no. 2 Rejia Khatun and for that reason for getting the land pre-empted due to her necessity after obtaining the certified copy of the case kabla on 15.03.1997 A.D. filed the original case for pre-emption under section 96 of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950. The further case of the pre-emptor-opposite party no.1 is such that she has no other land excepting her purchased 05 decimals of land.
